hook: Low tide returned the money Jason had thrown away. Lucia wished the harbor had kept its mouth shut.
alternative_hooks: The harbor returned the money. Jason had to refuse it again.
Their rent was late when the discarded cash washed back.
alternative_hook_use: Replace scene 1 and re-time/recount the master before production; do not append.
script: Low tide returned the money Jason had thrown away. Lucia wished the harbor had kept its mouth shut. The transparent pouch lay tangled beneath the public pier, where he'd dropped it after their argument. They stood above it, waiting. Back then, keeping the money had meant breaking a promise. Now their rent was late. Jason climbed down the public steps and lifted the pouch from the mud. Lucia said nothing. He counted through the plastic, lips moving, already rebuilding the life that money could buy. Then a marina worker pointed to the donation box for storm repairs. Its glass front held three coins. Jason looked from the pouch to Lucia. He pushed it through the collection slot before reconsidering. They walked home with wet shoes and the same overdue rent. This time, the money stayed thrown away.
plot_mechanism: temptation returns; voluntary public restitution closes the conflict
